Task Description:
Add matrix expansion. A target can have `matrix = {key = ["val1", "val2"], ...}`. The target is expanded into one concrete target per cartesian-product combination, replacing `${key}` in `name`, `command`, `dependencies`, `inputs`, `outputs`, and `env` values. Expanded names must be unique across all targets -- exit 1 with an error if not. Non-matrix targets stay as-is. Other targets can depend on expanded names. A target can have `matrix_include` -- an array of full combination maps appended to the cartesian product (if a combination is already in the product, it is not duplicated). A target can have `matrix_exclude` -- an array of partial combination maps; any combination matching all keys in any exclude entry is dropped. Order: product, then include, then exclude. Include entries must specify exactly the same keys as the matrix; exit 1 if they don't. Matrix substitution happens before pipeline variable expansion, so `${key}` in a matrix target always resolves to the matrix value, never a pipeline variable with the same name.
